high_level_description: This image is an infographic from WikiLeaks, celebrating 10 years of publishing over one million documents. The theme of the infographic is "NSA World Leaders Targets," highlighting some of the most highly classified documents ever published by a media organization. Title: "WikiLeaks TOP 10 PUBLICATIONS" Number: "9 NSA WORLD LEADERS TARGETS" Year: "2016" Subtitle: "The NSA World Leaders Targets reveal NSA targets including UN Secretary General Ban Ki-Moon's meetings with Heads of State, Prime Ministers Berlusconi
